description: This file defines the AppDatabase class using Room, an Android ORM library, which serves as the local database for the Quick Transfer app. It includes configuration for the database schema with one entity, ProfileEntity, and provides a singleton access method.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase that provides access to profile data via profileDao(). It implements singleton pattern for database instance management.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the DAO (Data Access Object) for ProfileEntity, enabling database operations related to profiles.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of AppDatabase, creating it if necessary, using the Room.databaseBuilder with specified configurations.
